name: Silver Sable

abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Instant Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Critical Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Disorient: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu ve blok yeterliliğini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fervor: Giden hasar veren etkilerin yetenek doğruluğunu artırır.

signatureAbility:
On The Hunt
Activating a Special Attack grants a +[107.55 - 538.43] Cruelty Passive for each Shock effect on the Opponent for 15 seconds. Max stacks: 10
Light and Medium Attacks that Intercept the Opponent have a chance to inflict an additional S:I Bounty Hunter Shock Debuff with +[10 - 60]% flat increased Ability Accuracy.

abilitySections.title: S:I Bounty Hunter
content: Light and Medium Attacks: 30% chance to inflict a Shock Debuff dealing [7,528.5] Energy Damage over 30 seconds. Max stacks: 30
Heavy Attacks: Cannot Miss, and the final hit inflicts a non-stacking 40% Disorient Passive for 18 seconds. Against Science Champions, the potency is 100%.
When a personal Shock effect fails to trigger due to Immunity, deal a burst of [8,066.25] Energy Damage.

abilitySections.title: Sable Mine
content: If the Opponent moves into a Sable Mine, it triggers, inflicting an instant Shock dealing a burst of [3,226.5] Energy Damage. That Sable Mine then goes on cooldown for 4 seconds, deactivating the burst Damage and Critical Shock effect. Mines are not triggered during Opponent's Special Attacks.
All Sable Mine cooldowns are removed upon performing an Intercept or punishing a Special Attack.
As an Attacker, if Silver Sable passes over a Sable Mine, she's granted a 80% Fervor Passive for 12 seconds and Purifies 1 non-Damaging Debuff. Max Fervor Stacks: 3.
Knocking Silver Sable into or over a Sable Mine via a Heavy Attack, Special Attack 1 or Special Attack 2 removes the Mine without triggering it.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On the final hit, set a Sable Mine in front of the Opponent that arms after 2 seconds and lasts until the next Sable Mine is set. Each subsequent Special Attack 1 sets an additional Sable Mine, up to a max of 3.
As a Defender, the Sable Mine spawns at Silver Sable's location, arms immediately, and only 1 can be set.
On the final hit, inflict a Tracking Passive for 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The first hit grants a non-stacking +[10,755] Cruelty Buff for 20 seconds.

If the Opponent is knocked into a Sable Mine via a Special Attack 2, convert up to 15 personal Shock Debuffs into Critical Shock Passives. These last 5 seconds and multiply their potency by Silver Sable's Critical Damage Multiplier.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Refresh all personal Buffs, Debuffs, and Passives and pause them for 20 seconds.
Deal a burst of [21,510] Energy Damage. Additionally, detonate all Sable Mines, dealing an additional burst for each Mine and setting them all on cooldown.
